parameters.name: K8sClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the Kubernetes cluster whose namespace information you want to synchronize to ASM. The Kubernetes cluster is added to the ASM instance that is specified by the ServiceMeshId parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh update-asm-namespace-from-guest-cluster --service-mesh-id cbf9ca9e6d5dc4c87a3ecd0ebf1e00000 --k8s-cluster-id c6f6d46583def494ba1f2e2937c800000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh UpdateASMNamespaceFromGuestCluster --region cn-hangzhou --ServiceMeshId cbf9ca9e6d5dc4c87a3ecd0ebf1e00000 --K8sClusterId c6f6d46583def494ba1f2e2937c800000
